classification.difficultyReason: Plot coordinate pairs, form intervals, and extract signed rise and positive run; the final pair requires moving from D to C to work left to right.

content.prompt: Plot these points on the Cartesian plane and calculate the gradient of the interval.

spec.description: Square Cartesian grid with equal units, integer ticks, double-ended axes and no axis titles.
spec.mathematics: Both coordinate ranges are −5 to 5; grid and tick interval 1; zero is unlabelled.
spec.answerVisibility: No points, labels, interval or rise/run guides in the question.
